command: import Foundation; import Compression; for (name, codec) in [("DEFLATE", COMPRESSION_ZLIB), ("LZFSE", COMPRESSION_LZFSE), ("LZ4", COMPRESSION_LZ4)] { for count in [1, 99, 100, 101, 128] { let data = Data(repeating: 65, count: count); data.withUnsafeBytes { (source: UnsafeRawBufferPointer) in let destination = UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>.allocate(capacity: 1024); defer { destination.deallocate() }; let result = compression_encode_buffer(destination, 1024, source.bindMemory(to: UInt8.self).baseAddress!, count, nil, codec); print(name, count, result) } } }
containment_limits: Only lineages observed before reparenting are owned; instant unobserved daemonization can escape.
Identity check and kill are separate syscalls; PID reuse in that interval cannot be excluded.
Zombie means no executing process; non-child zombie reaping belongs to its parent.
SIGKILL of the runner or host failure can bypass cleanup; Linux is unsupported and unvalidated.
